naming_notes: Working references contains only the hash-matched existing design anchor in this drop; likeness/finish anchors outside this manifest remain in the separate casting map.
Tattoos & piercings includes primary artwork references and related pointers to useful outfit/story close-ups. Related pointers are not extra primary images.
DJ beast, Armored enforcer, Ivory-coat woman and Hooded traveler describe the actual received concept families; they do not newly assign Chewbacca, Thick Vader, Leia or Stephen/Lisan identity.
All views means a source contact sheet displayed contextually inside its outfit/cast album, never as a new character or primary gallery cover.
The title Final portrait replaces source wording final-lock-face for SB-34 so a story concept does not appear newly approved.
Source inspiration and Earlier pass labels are short presentation notes; full technical evidence remains in the source manifest.
